subject: [PATCH 02/10] mm/madvise: name the shared LRU PMD callback

2026-09-22.patch_summary: This patch renames the shared LRU PMD callback in the Linux kernel's mm/madvise.c file to better reflect its purpose and functionality. The callback, previously named madvise_cold_or_pageout_pte_range, is responsible for handling MADV_COLD and MADV_PAGEOUT page-walk operations. By renaming it to madvise_lru_pmd_entry, the code becomes more descriptive and easier to understand. This change does not introduce any functional changes, but rather improves code clarity.
